# Legacy Mainframe COBOL Job Control Language (JCL) Reference

- **Source**: Archival System Documentation (1985)
- **Topic**: Mainframe / COBOL (Unrelated Noise Document)

This document describes batch job submission for IBM OS/390 mainframes and Job Control Language (JCL) syntax.
It details DD statements, SYSIN datasets, card punch routines, and tape storage allocation algorithms.
None of the content here relates to SAP ERP, ABAP programming, HANA databases, or S/4HANA migrations.
This document exists exclusively in the test corpus to demonstrate and evaluate vector reranking and semantic noise filtering.

metadata.section: Legacy Mainframe COBOL Job Control Language (JCL) Reference

# SAP Custom Code Adaptation Guide for S/4HANA & ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC)

- **Source**: SAP Community & Custom Code Migration Guide for S/4HANA
- **Topic**: Custom Code (ABAP / Basis)
- **S/4HANA Release**: 1809 to 2023 / 2026

metadata.source: SAP Community & Custom Code Migration Guide for S/4HANA
metadata.title: SAP Custom Code Adaptation Guide for S/4HANA & ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC)
metadata.section: SAP Custom Code Adaptation Guide for S/4HANA & ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC)

chunk_id: SAP Custom Code Adaptation Guide for S/4HANA & ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC)_1
text:
## 1. Custom Code Migration Methodology
The custom code migration process for SAP S/4HANA follows three distinct phases:
1. **Scoping**: Identify custom code that is actually executed in production (using Usage and Procedure Logging - UPL, or ABAP Call Monitor - SCMON via CCLM). Unused code should be retired/deleted rather than migrated.
2. **Analysis**: Execute the ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC) with the check variant `S4HANA_READINESS` (or remote ATC from an S/4HANA system).
3. **Adaptation**: Remediate critical syntax errors, functional incompatibilities, and database-specific dependencies.

metadata.source: SAP Community & Custom Code Migration Guide for S/4HANA
metadata.title: SAP Custom Code Adaptation Guide for S/4HANA & ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC)
metadata.section: SAP Custom Code Adaptation Guide for S/4HANA & ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC)

chunk_id: SAP Custom Code Adaptation Guide for S/4HANA & ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC)_2
text:
## 2. Key Code Patterns Requiring Remediation
- **Native SQL (`EXEC SQL ... ENDEXEC`)**:
  Native SQL bypasses the SAP database interface and Open SQL optimizations. In S/4HANA on SAP HANA DB, native SQL written for Oracle/DB2/SQL Server will fail or bypass columnar indexing and security.
  *Remediation*: Rewrite using Open SQL (modern ABAP SQL) or AMDP (ABAP Managed Database Procedures).
- **Direct Database Modifications on Standard SAP Tables**:
  ABAP statements modifying standard tables directly (`INSERT INTO MARA`, `UPDATE VBAK`, `MODIFY BSEG`) bypass application logic, data dictionaries, and document numbering invariants.
  *Remediation*: Use standard BAPIs or RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model) business objects.
- **Obsolete Statements and Database Hints**:
  - `CLIENT SPECIFIED` clause is obsolete in modern Open SQL (use `USING CLIENT`).
  - Database-specific hints (`%_HINTS ORACLE ...`) have no effect or cause syntax warnings in SAP HANA.
  - Assumptions on implicit sorting: In ECC, `SELECT` without an `ORDER BY` often returned records sorted by primary key due to database engine behavior. In SAP HANA (column store), record order without `ORDER BY` is non-deterministic.
- **Obsolete Function Modules**:
  Function modules such as `WS_DELIVERY_UPDATE`, `BAPI_CUSTOMER_CREATE`, and old FI posting routines are replaced by streamlined S/4HANA interfaces and RAP business objects.

metadata.source: SAP Community & Custom Code Migration Guide for S/4HANA
metadata.title: SAP Custom Code Adaptation Guide for S/4HANA & ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC)
metadata.section: SAP Custom Code Adaptation Guide for S/4HANA & ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC)

# SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Financial Line Items (ACDOCA vs BSEG)

- **Source**: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Item S4H_SI_FIN_001
- **Topic**: Finance (FI/CO)
- **S/4HANA Release**: 1511 to 2023 / 2026

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Item S4H_SI_FIN_001
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Financial Line Items (ACDOCA vs BSEG)
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Financial Line Items (ACDOCA vs BSEG)

chunk_id: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Financial Line Items (ACDOCA vs BSEG)_1
text:
## 1. Overview and Architectural Change
In SAP ECC 6.0, financial accounting (FI) and controlling (CO) were separated across distinct database tables. Detail line items were recorded in `BSEG`, with secondary indexes stored in tables such as `BSIS`, `BSAS` (G/L accounts), `BSID`, `BSAD` (Customers), and `BSIK`, `BSAK` (Vendors). General ledger totals were maintained in `GLT0` or `FAGLFLEXT`.

In SAP S/4HANA, the Universal Journal table `ACDOCA` (Universal Journal Entry Line Items) replaces the separate line item tables and index tables. `ACDOCA` combines FI, CO, AA (Asset Accounting), ML (Material Ledger), and Profitability Analysis into a single line-item table containing over 350 columns.

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Item S4H_SI_FIN_001
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Financial Line Items (ACDOCA vs BSEG)
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Financial Line Items (ACDOCA vs BSEG)

chunk_id: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Financial Line Items (ACDOCA vs BSEG)_2
text:
## 2. Impact on Custom ABAP Code
- **Direct Queries on BSEG / BSIS / BSAS**:
  Direct `SELECT` queries on `BSEG`, `BSIS`, or `BSAS` in custom reports will either trigger severe performance degradation or fail to retrieve newly posted entries because secondary index tables (`BSIS`, `BSAS`, `BSIK`, etc.) are now implemented as compatibility views rather than physical transparent tables.
- **Compatibility Views**:
  SAP provides DDL compatibility views for `BSIS`, `BSAS`, `BSID`, `BSAD`, `BSIK`, and `BSAK`. However, reading from these compatibility views performs an on-the-fly calculation and union against `ACDOCA`, which can be computationally expensive if queries are not filtered on indexed fields.
- **Cluster/Pool Behavior**:
  Legacy operations treating `BSEG` as a cluster table or using database hints `%_HINTS` are obsolete.

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Item S4H_SI_FIN_001
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Financial Line Items (ACDOCA vs BSEG)
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Financial Line Items (ACDOCA vs BSEG)

chunk_id: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Financial Line Items (ACDOCA vs BSEG)_3
text:
## 3. Recommended Remediation
1. Refactor Open SQL queries to select from the Universal Journal `ACDOCA` or use modern Core Data Services (CDS) views (such as `I_JournalEntryItem`).
2. Use SAP-delivered standard APIs and BAPIs (`BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST`) for financial postings rather than manual table modifications.
3. For custom reports requiring line items, specify mandatory filters on `RCLNT` (Client), `RLDNR` (Ledger), `RBUKRS` (Company Code), and `GJAHR` (Fiscal Year) to leverage the primary partition of `ACDOCA`.

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Item S4H_SI_FIN_001
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Financial Line Items (ACDOCA vs BSEG)
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Financial Line Items (ACDOCA vs BSEG)

# SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)

- **Source**: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Items S4H_SI_MM_003 / S4H_SI_BP_001
- **Topic**: Materials Management (MM) & Business Partner (BP)
- **S/4HANA Release**: 1511 to 2023 / 2026

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Items S4H_SI_MM_003 / S4H_SI_BP_001
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)

chunk_id: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)_1
text:
## 1. Material Documents: MKPF and MSEG replaced by MATDOC
In SAP ECC 6.0, inventory movements were recorded across two primary tables: `MKPF` (Material Document Header) and `MSEG` (Material Document Segment / Line Items). Valuation tables included `MBEW`, `MARD`, etc.

In SAP S/4HANA:
- All inventory movements and stock ledger entries are unified into a single transparent table: `MATDOC` (Material Document Line Items).
- Tables `MKPF` and `MSEG` are replaced by compatibility views. Physical writes to `MKPF` and `MSEG` are strictly prohibited.
- Aggregated inventory tables (like `MARD`, `MSLB`, `MCHB`) are calculated on-the-fly from `MATDOC` records, eliminating database lock contention during high-volume goods receipts.

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Items S4H_SI_MM_003 / S4H_SI_BP_001
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)

chunk_id: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)_2
text:
## 2. Material Number Field Extension (MATNR: 18 to 40 characters)
In SAP ECC 6.0, the `MATNR` domain had a length of 18 characters (`CHAR18`).
In SAP S/4HANA:
- The `MATNR` field length is extended to 40 characters (`CHAR40`).
- Custom code with hardcoded length definitions, concatenation offsets (`DATA lv_matnr(18) TYPE c`), or substring operations (`lv_matnr+0(18)`) will cause data truncation, silent corruption, or syntax errors.
- External formats and interfaces (BAPIs, IDOCs, EDI, RFC) must be reviewed for length compatibility.

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Items S4H_SI_MM_003 / S4H_SI_BP_001
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)

chunk_id: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)_3
text:
## 3. Customer and Vendor Master Integration (Business Partner Approach)
In SAP ECC 6.0, customer master records resided in `KNA1`, `KNB1`, `KNVV`, and vendor master records resided in `LFA1`, `LFB1`, `LFM1`.

In SAP S/4HANA:
- The SAP Business Partner (`BUT000`, `BUT020`, `BUT100`) is the mandatory single point of entry for managing master data for business partners, customers, and vendors (CVI - Customer Vendor Integration).
- Direct maintenance of `KNA1` and `LFA1` transactions (e.g. `FD01`, `FK01`, `XD01`, `XK01`) is obsolete and redirects to transaction `BP`.
- While read compatibility exists for `KNA1`/`LFA1` for basic reporting, write operations and synchronization must be handled through CVI services and Business Partner APIs.

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Items S4H_SI_MM_003 / S4H_SI_BP_001
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)

chunk_id: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)_4
text:
## 4. Recommended Remediation
1. Refactor inventory queries to select from `MATDOC` or standard CDS views (`C_MaterialStockByKeyDate`).
2. Replace hardcoded `CHAR18` definitions with `TYPE matnr` or the data element `MATNR_DISPLAY`.
3. Migrate customer/vendor master maintenance logic to CVI and Business Partner BAPIs (`BAPI_BUPA_*`).

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Items S4H_SI_MM_003 / S4H_SI_BP_001
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Material Management (MATDOC, MATNR, Business Partner)

# SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model

- **Source**: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Item S4H_SI_SD_002
- **Topic**: Sales and Distribution (SD)
- **S/4HANA Release**: 1610 to 2023 / 2026

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Item S4H_SI_SD_002
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model

chunk_id: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model_1
text:
## 1. Overview and Status Field Relocation
In SAP ECC 6.0, header-level and item-level processing statuses for sales and billing documents were stored centrally in tables `VBUK` (Header Status) and `VBUP` (Item Status). 

In SAP S/4HANA:
- Header status fields (e.g., `GBSTK`, `LFSTK`, `WBSTK`, `FKSTK`) have been moved directly into the corresponding document header tables:
  - Sales Orders: `VBAK`
  - Deliveries: `LIKP`
  - Billing Documents: `VBRK`
- Item status fields (e.g., `GBSTA`, `LFSTA`, `WBSTA`, `FKSTA`) have been moved directly into the document item tables:
  - Sales Order Items: `VBAP`
  - Delivery Items: `LIPS`
  - Billing Document Items: `VBRP`

Tables `VBUK` and `VBUP` are no longer updated as transparent application tables. They exist only as compatibility views for read access.

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Item S4H_SI_SD_002
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model

chunk_id: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model_2
text:
## 2. Pricing Conditions Data Model (KONV -> PRCD_ELEMENTS)
In SAP ECC 6.0, condition records for documents were stored in cluster table `KONV`.
In SAP S/4HANA:
- Table `KONV` is replaced by the transparent table `PRCD_ELEMENTS`.
- Direct queries or custom code reading or writing to `KONV` will fail or hit compatibility views with performance overhead.

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Item S4H_SI_SD_002
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model

chunk_id: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model_3
text:
## 3. Impact on Custom ABAP Code
- Code executing `SELECT ... FROM VBUK` or `SELECT ... FROM VBUP` joins will suffer significant performance degradation because compatibility views emulate the old structure with large outer joins.
- Code updating `VBUK` or `VBUP` directly (`UPDATE VBUK ...`) will fail with runtime database errors (`DBSQL_TABLE_UNKNOWN` or read-only view exceptions).
- Pricing routines reading `KONV` directly must be replaced with accesses to `PRCD_ELEMENTS` or standard pricing APIs (`PRICING_COMPLETE`, etc.).

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Item S4H_SI_SD_002
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model

chunk_id: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model_4
text:
## 4. Recommended Remediation
1. Adjust queries to select status attributes directly from `VBAK` (Header) and `VBAP` (Item) or their CDS view counterparts `I_SalesOrder` and `I_SalesOrderItem`.
2. Replace all references to `KONV` with `PRCD_ELEMENTS`. Ensure field types match the extended definitions.

metadata.source: SAP Help Portal & S/4HANA Simplification Item S4H_SI_SD_002
metadata.title: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model
metadata.section: SAP S/4HANA Simplification Item: Sales Document Status and Pricing Data Model
